statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Delayed late-session NQ futures were near the session high while lower yields, lower oil and broad technology strength aligned with trend-up conditions.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES; the late-session configuration is elevated because near-high retention and cross-asset alignment increase continuation risk, while earlier two-way trade and delayed direct pricing limit the Tail estimate.
headline: Late-session near-high retention lifts Tail into the elevated band
body: Delayed December NQ futures were about 1.65% higher at 18:14 UTC and roughly 15 points below the session high. Reuters also reported lower Treasury yields and oil, a softer VIX, and broad technology and chip strength. Earlier two-way trade and the delay in direct NQ evidence keep Tail only just above the block threshold.

lookbackSummary: Tail was elevated around the prior FOMC sequence, fell overnight, rose into the U.S. session, briefly reached elevated at 16:00 UTC, then returned to WATCH at 17:00-18:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Tail is elevated for the current power hour because delayed NQ data showed late-session near-high retention with aligned cross-assets. Risk is expected to decay after the cash close unless one-way extension persists, then rebuild conditionally around Friday's U.S. data and cash-open checkpoints.
